steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Chengxiao...?
In a daze, you grasp his hand, and your palm recognizes the familiar slick, icy sensation at once.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You... went into the Void of Yin in this body?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Not to that extreme, no.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Still, a journey like this exacts its toll, one way or another.
He pulls his hand back as though it were nothing, and tugs his sleeve down to hide the mark blooming dark across his wrist.
And you can do nothing. Just as before.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Your divination was right. Every last bit of it was right.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I thought I could talk her down and stop her. But I couldn't. Every time I tried, I just pushed her further.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The fact that I'm here at all already proves the ending was set. It was only ever a question of when.
A torrent of words spills from your chest, carrying a conviction so firm it feels alien on your own tongue.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So it was all inevitable, wasn't it?
Chengxiao looks at you for a long while. He doesn't nod. Only a soft sigh escapes through his nose.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Perhaps it was.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Though after all of this, I find myself wondering... most people who seek out divination are really just looking for someone to tell them they made the right choice. And fate, perhaps, is simply the place people arrive at after walking the road they had already chosen for themselves.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: People, even when they know better, can't bring themselves to betray their own hearts.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Venturing into the Void of Yin, pursuing its secrets, standing against the calamities... she had made up her mind about all of it long before we ever set foot in Maria City. Even if it meant surrendering herself to evil, it was, as she put it, no terribly ill omen.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Had she done anything less, she would not have been the person I know.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: The same applies to me. Willing or not, here I am all the same. Is that not proof enough?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Whether you were present or not, we would have ended up standing before that so-called "god" regardless. The outcome has nothing to do with you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nothing to do with me...
He gives a single nod, draws himself upright, and turns his gaze toward the far horizon.
Maria City lies quiet now, so still it feels strange. Only a faint tremor hums beneath your feet. With the Apostle sealed inside the Void of Yin, this is nearly the end of all things.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I still can't leave.
The faint light catches Chengxiao's glasses, flashing and hiding whatever lies behind his eyes.
<i>Are you still not turning back, even at this point?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Truth is, there's a lot I still want to ask her, to ask both of you. Even if that chance is gone now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're both Daoists, aren't you? And pretty good at reading fate. You must have seen your own endings long before I ever showed up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So why did you still set out? Why...
<i>Why did it have to be this way?
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: That was the path they had to walk, in their time.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: And now, this is my path to walk.
[End of Flashback]
At last, you understand her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Because...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you weren't here right now... or I guess, for me, if you had never <color=#fb9259>been</color> here... my world wouldn't exist. I wouldn't be here at all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What would that world even look like? I don't know.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So even knowing how it ends...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No. Precisely because I know how it ends for you all, I want to see it through with you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This has everything to do with me.
Even if this is all but a dream.
You breathe in deep, raise your chin, settle your shoulders back, and look straight at him.

steps.speaker: Mechanical Sound
steps.content: And if you two really are the ones who left behind a way to suppress the Apostle for Eastia...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even with Lichen gone, merged into the Apostle... that'll only hold it for so long. It's going to break loose eventually, and when it does, your expedition is in for a whole lot worse.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't know if we can actually do this...
No Almighty Bow. No power drawn from the mass. Only a single person who has made peace with her own ruin, suspended somewhere between life and death.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But we have to take that monster, and whatever's inside it—
Your mouth opens, and the sound that slips out is almost a sigh. You grit your teeth and manage to push the words through.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We put it down for good.
Chengxiao doesn't move. The wind slips through the space between you, catching the edge of his sleeve and lifting it for just a moment.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: ...No matter how I read the hexagrams, it seems I truly cannot divine what lies beyond the boundary of my own fate.
Chengxiao breaks into an unexpected laugh.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Thank you. Now I can set out with an easy mind.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Ah, and when you see Li Xianling, do be careful not to mention you assumed she was dead. She would make quite the scene afterward.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You... believe Lichen is still alive?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Believe? It would be more accurate to say I do not.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Li Xianling has had a gift for finding loopholes ever since we were children.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Once, she was caught mocking the Celestial Master's statue. She turned right around and, in that pompous old classical style, declared she was simply offended that anyone would dare imprison the great Celestial Master in the mortal realm with something as earthly as stone.
A brief laugh escapes him, then his hand snaps shut, the mud still clinging to his fingers leaving dark, wet marks pressed into his palm.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: So, I do not believe she would allow herself to be killed by the very thing she holds in the greatest contempt.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Look.
You lift your gaze and realize the fissures in the sky never truly sealed. They've been pulled taut into a single seam, its light quivering as if someone is wrestling to keep it closed.
The sound of pattering footsteps draws closer.

steps.speaker: Keylan
steps.content: Data checks out. The anomalous fluctuations in the Reflection Plane are being suppressed. How long that'll hold, though...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: It will suffice. The creature will not emerge again until we find it.
Chengxiao lowers himself into a crouch. He takes out a paper talisman and a short blade, then draws the edge across his fingertip. Blood beads and falls, winding into a formation on the ground.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: This formation will send me into the Void of Yin, to where my soul is. It will take some time. You may have to wait a while for me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So entering the Void of Yin takes a ritual this complicated...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: One could force one's way in, I suppose. But I cannot bring myself to adopt her methods. Proper preparation is always preferable.
[CG]

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: You see? People truly do not change.
In the dim light, he looks at you with a knowing smile, waiting. But as ever, he already knows what you will say.
He reaches out his hand toward you.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Are you ready?
You lower your gaze to your open palm. Beneath the skin, your veins throb with a quiet, rhythmic pulse.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm ready.
